## Stridulate community identification

- **Record ID:** STR-
- **iNaturalist observation:** https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/
- **Current community taxon:** Awaiting identification
- **Stridulate outcome:** No confident match / Possible match
- **Approximate context:** Broad region only; do not post a private exact location

The scheduled repository workflow can post the latest public iNaturalist identification status below and distinguishes broad IDs from species-level IDs. It does **not** download the iNaturalist sound or automatically accept a label for training.

Once the original recorder has independently reviewed the result and approved their original local WAV under **CC BY 4.0**, attach the Stridulate contribution ZIP to this issue.
